name: sgs/nav-menu
title: SGS Nav Menu
description: The site's primary navigation bar. A flat horizontal row of real links on desktop; below the collapse point it becomes a burger that opens the sgs/nav-drawer via the shared sgs/nav Interactivity store. Menu content comes from a native WordPress menu.

wrapper.label: Nav wrapper
wrapper._note: The rendered <nav> (SGS_Container_Wrapper, composite-mirror rule R-31-9). Padding/margin ride the native spacing support; max-width is the flat attribute. navBg/navColour/navBgHover all write to the same bare $uid_sel wrapper selector (2026-08-28 fix — navBg previously only resolved via a hand-seeded attr-classification-overrides.json entry, not derivation; that override entry is now redundant, kept for now as a separate cleanup). The 12 ARRANGEMENT members (layer OUTER) — display/flex-direction/align-items/justify-content etc. — are honest GAPs: style.css:13-17 hardcodes `display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between` with no attribute behind any of it. Not fixed here — out of this task's scope (only STATE_WITHOUT_BASE cases are fixed).

bar.label: Item bar (flex row)
bar._note: The <ul class="sgs-nav-menu__bar"> that actually arranges the item links — distinct from `wrapper`, which arranges the bar against the burger toggle-wrap. Remaining ARRANGEMENT members are honest GAPs (style.css:19-26 hardcodes `display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap` with no attribute).

item.label: Nav item (resting)
item._note: render.php:953-957 defines `$hover_targets` as `:hover, :focus-visible` ONLY. `[aria-current="page"]` was removed 2026-07-31 (render.php:1476-1480 gives it distinct treatment: font-weight:600 top-level, border-left+background in drawer) so a visitor can distinguish WHERE THEY ARE from WHAT THEY ARE POINTING AT. NO `selected` state is declared. A duplicate `selected` attrMap (byte-identical to `hover`) was REMOVED 2026-08-19: the classifier's _record() is last-write-wins (extract-signatures.py:1966-1983), so `selected` iterated second and silently overwrote the correct hover derivation, tagging all three attributes css_state='selected' in the DB - a state they never render in. Keeping it 'for schema consistency' made the metadata factually wrong. This block has NO operator-controllable current-page colour at all; adding one is separate work (FR-35-5). underlineThickness/underlineOffset/underlineColour(Hover) belong to the separate `underline` element, not this one — they only apply under hoverStyle='underline'.

underline.label: Hover / current-page underline bar
underline._note: The ::after bar rendered only when hoverStyle='underline' (render.php:369-377). underlineThickness maps to css:height (the bar's own height, not the item's) and underlineOffset maps to css:bottom (its position:absolute offset) — both attrMap'd explicitly since neither matches the default {prefix}{suffix} convention for those members. `selected` reuses the same hover state (render.php's $hover_after_sel covers :hover/:focus-visible/[aria-current] identically), so no separate selected mapping is declared to avoid a duplicate finding. underlineColourGradient added 2026-09-04 (D948 rollout) -- non-empty wins over underlineColour, resting state only (mirrors indicatorColourGradient's precedent: a standalone decorative element with no competing background on the same selector, so a direct swap via sgs_background_paint_decl() is safe, no ::after-layer split needed).

indicator.label: Sliding indicator
indicator._note: indicatorColourGradient added 2026-09-04 (fix.js codemod apply, Bug A fix) -- non-empty wins over indicatorColour. The `.sgs-nav-menu__indicator` sliding pill (render.php:1582-1583), view.js-animated behind the active/hovered item — only rendered when `indicatorStyle='pill'`. Added 2026-08-15, no manifest element previously covered it. `indicatorColour` mapped explicitly (attrMap) rather than via the default `{prefix}Suffix` convention: the fill cluster's css:background-color member only lists `BackgroundColour`/`Bg`/`Background` suffixes, none of which matches `indicatorColour`'s bare `Colour` form. `clusters: ["fill"]` is declared (not `[]`) SPECIFICALLY so the forward-resolution pass actually visits css:background-color and consults this attrMap — an attrMap on an element with `clusters: []` is never consulted (nothing ever iterates it), which was caught live: the first version of this fix (clusters: []) left indicatorColour unclaimed and it surfaced as a NEW style-defect orphan instead of resolving. The other fill-cluster members (opacity/background-image/etc.) become honest GAPs — ungated, and correct, since this element has no such controls.

featured.label: Featured item
featured._note: render.php:431-459. featuredFontWeightHover is a genuine hover-state weight change (only emitted when it differs from resting), declared under `text` cluster's css:font-weight member. featuredColourGradient added 2026-09-04 (mirrors burgerColourGradient's shape) -- explicit attrMap since css:color-gradient is not resolved by the default {prefix}Suffix convention, same reason burgerColourGradient needed one. Resting LABEL form only; PILL form and the submenu-inheritance custom property stay flat (see render.php comments).

burger.label: Burger toggle
burger._note: burgerColour is the icon TEXT colour (css:color, render.php:466-469); burgerHoverColour drives the button's HOVER background-color (render.php:479-482, was 470-473 pre-fix), which previously had no resting counterpart — a client could style the hover fill but never the button's own resting fill (STATE_WITHOUT_BASE, Spec 35 FR-35-5). Fixed 2026-07-21 by adding the `burgerBg` base attribute + inspector control (edit.js Burger panel, Normal state) so css:background-color now resolves at base too. Unset burgerBg renders byte-identical to before (style.css:73-88 `background:none` default).

sublink.label: Submenu link
sublink._note: The submenu LINK — <a class="sgs-nav-menu__sublink"> (render.php:410), painted at render.php's own scoped `.sgs-nav-menu__sublink{...}` rule. Declared explicitly because the emission classifier cannot reach it: prefix "" is the documented explicit opt-out from orphan-scanning: the sublink shares no name prefix with submenuColour, and a "submenu" prefix would wrongly try to claim submenuAlign/Caret/CloseGrace/MinWidth/Radius/Padding, which belong to the submenu PANEL rather than to this anchor. D956 (778879732 rollout, Phase 3): submenuColourGradient added as the text-colour gradient sibling — routed as a DIRECT decl (sgs_text_colour_decl/sgs_resolve_text_colour_or_gradient), replacing the previous --sgs-nm-submenu-colour custom-property indirection for this attribute, because a `var(--x, …)` chain feeding a fixed `color:` declaration cannot switch to `background-image` for a gradient (survey.js's `paints-via-colour-valued-custom-property` refusal reason).

attributes._note_nav_fill: Nav CONTAINER surface (2026-07-28). The block previously had NO fill controls at all — only per-ITEM colours — so a client could never sit the bar on its own surface. Scope is deliberately SURFACE ONLY: border/radius/divider were built and then REMOVED the same day (Bean ruling) because the pill-nav and bordered-nav patterns that justify them are whole-HEADER treatments, and sgs/site-header already declares `color` + `__experimentalBorder` supports for exactly that. Do not re-add them here without a header-level reason. Defaults unset, so an untouched nav renders byte-identically. Because the drawer holds its OWN sgs/nav-menu instance, these also give fully independent drawer styling with no extra plumbing.

navColourGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the nav text with a background-clip:text mechanism instead of a flat colour (D956 text-colour gradient rollout). Non-empty wins over navColour. Safe unconditionally -- navBg already paints on a separate ::after layer (sgs_block_background_layer_css()), never this same selector.

itemColourGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the resting nav-item text with a background-clip:text mechanism instead of a flat colour (D956 text-colour gradient rollout). Non-empty wins over itemColour. Safe unconditionally -- itemBg already paints on a ::before layer (D942 recipe item 1), never this same selector. Not offered on hover: itemColourHover's 'pill' style auto-computes its colour for WCAG contrast against itemBgHover.

itemBgGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the resting nav-item background via the same ::before layer as itemBg (D942 recipe item 1); non-empty wins over the flat itemBg colour, mirroring itemColourGradient's sibling-wins pattern.

featuredColourGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the featured bar item's LABEL-form text with a background-clip:text mechanism instead of a flat colour (mirrors burgerColourGradient). Non-empty wins over featuredColour. Resting LABEL form only (no featuredBg set) -- the PILL form (featuredBg set) keeps its WCAG-contrast-resolved flat foreground, and the submenu inheritance custom property (--sgs-nm-featured-colour) stays flat-only because its consumer paints a background on the same selector (see render.php).
